one_line_contribution: A crossed ablation arguing that retrieved agent memory helps mainly by supplying a scaffold — split into a surface tool-call-syntax channel and a procedural-schema channel — so that any adequate instruction (hand-written S_SPEC, GEPA, or MIPRO) substitutes for it, leaving memory's residual content channel as a net-negative contributor.
closest_prior_work: Min et al. (EMNLP 2022) is the acknowledged conceptual ancestor and the proposal handles it honestly, but it is not the sharpest threat. Synapse (Zheng et al., ICLR 2024) already abstracts retrieved trajectories by stripping task-specific state while preserving structure, and Agent Workflow Memory (Wang et al., 2024) already induces reusable procedural workflows rather than storing episode content — both are, in effect, arguments that the reusable part of experience is schema rather than content, which directly contradicts the Related Work claim that 'nobody removes content while holding format fixed.' The second threat is GEPA (Agrawal et al., 2025) itself, whose headline is that reflectively evolved instructions outperform demonstration-based prompt optimization; if that comparison already exists in print, P2 ('the optimizer's instruction slot substitutes for the demonstration slot') is a restatement, and only the syntax/schema split (E7) and the harm attribution (E3/P4) remain unclaimed. The MIPRO/DSPy component ablations on instructions-vs-bootstrapped-demos are a third, weaker version of the same collision.
strongest_objection: The confirmatory core is conditioned on a gain the authors' own pilot says does not exist, and the arithmetic that would interpret it is not a decomposition. (1) Gate E0 requires REAL to beat NONE at S0 by >=4 points, yet the track's motivating pilot reports that injected memory fixed zero items and broke six to seven; the expected denominator (REAL - NONE at S0) is therefore <=0, and P1, P2 and P3 all divide by it. Worse, E0 is run at n=200 while the paper's own power model (2.8 points at n=700, 12% discordance) implies an MDE near 5.2 points at n=200 — the gate threshold sits below what the gate can measure, so a study-defining branch is decided by noise. The declared fallback (harm-side results only) is precisely the pilot's already-published finding. (2) Even if the gate passes, the three 'channels' do not partition the gain: syntax (SCRAMBLE-C-SHUF - NONE) + schema (SCRAMBLE-C - SHUF) + content (REAL - CROSS) equals (REAL - NONE) only if acc(SCRAMBLE-C) = acc(CROSS), which nothing enforces and no arm checks. P1 (>=60%) and P3 (<=30%) can both be met with a large unaccounted or double-counted residual, and no coherence constraint is pre-registered. (3) P2's interaction is confounded with baseline level: S_GEPA raises accuracy, so a smaller REAL increment on top of it is the expected diminishing-return/ceiling pattern, not evidence of scaffold substitution — and the pre-registered threshold ('>=5 points falling to <=2 points') is stated in accuracy points while the single primary test is a logistic interaction on log-odds, where the two can license opposite conclusions on the same data. (4) SCRAMBLE-C-SHUF permutes action steps of a ReAct trace, so observations no longer follow the actions that produced them; the 'schema channel' estimate (SCRAMBLE-C minus SHUF) is contaminated by the penalty for an incoherent exemplar and can even go negative, which E7's promotion to confirmatory control does not fix.
what_would_fix_it: Four concrete changes. (a) Add S_VERBOSE: an instruction matched to S_GEPA in token count and register but containing no syntax, schema, step-budget or stopping information, and run the P2 interaction against it. Without this, every S_SPEC/S_GEPA contrast confounds 'the instruction states the scaffold' with 'the instruction is longer'; PAD length-matches the injection slot only, never the instruction slot. (b) Drop the ratio framing unless acc(SCRAMBLE-C) ~ acc(CROSS) is empirically verified: report syntax, schema and content in raw accuracy points with an explicit residual term, and pre-register the primary contrast and its threshold on one scale (log-odds), with the accuracy-point version demoted to secondary. (c) Run the gate at full n=700, or raise the gate threshold to what n=200 can detect; and given the pilot, make the harm-side paper (E3/P4 plus substitution-on-harm) the primary deliverable rather than the fallback, so the contribution does not evaporate on a coin flip. (d) Replace the full permutation in SCRAMBLE-C-SHUF with a coherence-preserving reordering (swap two independent sub-goal blocks) so the schema estimate is not the cost of exemplar incoherence, and restore one affordance-bearing environment (ALFWorld or WebShop) at reduced n — on search-tool multi-hop QA there is almost no experience-idiosyncratic content for memory to carry, so the deflationary result is close to guaranteed and correspondingly uninformative, and E9, the only arm that looks for the boundary, is explicitly underpowered at n~100 per stratum.
missing_baseline: The optimizer's own demonstration slot. MIPRO is run with demonstration bootstrapping disabled and GEPA with no exemplars, so the plan never evaluates optimizer-selected bootstrapped demonstrations drawn from the 100-item dev slice (call it BOOTSTRAP-DEMO) as an injection condition. That is the cheapest content-bearing competitor to retrieved memory and the composition the field actually deploys; without it the claim 'memory earns its tokens only on experience-idiosyncratic content' is never tested against static optimized demos, and FIXED-REAL does not stand in for it because it involves no selection or optimization. Second omission: the length-matched instruction control S_VERBOSE described above.
preprint_collision: The check is not thin — it is empty, and the authors say so. Zero searches completed across two consecutive revisions, novelty argued entirely from unverified recollection, and the prior version carried a fabricated arXiv identifier (retracted here, to their credit). By the standard that an unsearched novelty claim is a weakness rather than a neutral, this alone caps novelty: the proposal has not established that E1 is unclaimed. I cannot name a 2026 preprint from inside this review either, but I can name the checks that must be run before submission and that the authors' own recollection already puts at risk: GEPA (Agrawal et al., 2025) on instruction evolution outperforming demonstration-based optimization, which is P2 in different clothing; Synapse and Agent Workflow Memory, which already strip episode content while retaining structure; the MIPRO/DSPy instructions-vs-demonstrations component ablations; and the 2025 ReasoningBank line plus the fast-moving 'context rot / long-context distractor' preprint cluster, which is the most likely home of a paper that already attributes injected-memory harm to topically-plausible distractor content. The stated collision policy (re-position onto E5/E7 if E1 collides) is sensible, but a policy is not a search, and the fallback contribution — the syntax/schema split plus the hand-written-spec substitution — is a thinner paper than the one being reviewed.
